pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The city’s official MSIP catalog identifies an EGiB cadastral parcel vector dataset owned by the Mayor of Kraków and published by the Geodesy Department. The city BIP metadata names EGiB and a daily update path. The published feature schema contains parcel key, parcel number, unit/precinct names, area, import date, and geometry, with no owner or address field.
remainingUncertainty: No citywide query, pagination, freshness, topological or legal-title assessment was performed; the sampled geometry is a public cadastre representation, not a guarantee of title or survey accuracy.

officialSources.observation: Official MSIP catalog publishes the cadastral parcels as vector data in EPSG:2178, with SHP/DXF/JSON downloads and WMS/WFS links; data owner is Mayor of Kraków / City Geodesy Department. Terms restrict personal data and otherwise refer to city reuse rules.
Official city catalog describes the WMS as EGiB parcel data without personal data and identifies the City Geodesy Department as owner.
City BIP EGiB metadata identifies the Geodesy Department, subject data including parcels and daily updating from PZGiK object data; its listed WMS format is image output.
Official national Geoportal explains EGiB custodianship by starosts/cities with county rights, daily aggregated WFS and that WFS returns full parcel/building geometries subject to the county feeds.

viewerAndServiceTrace.notes: WFS GetCapabilities and DescribeFeatureType HTTP 200. Layer is dzialki_ewidencyjne, EPSG:2178, polygon; schema contains safe parcel identifiers, area, date and geometry but no owner/address fields. Exact-point query through the official service returned one full polygon. Requested only id_dzialki, numer_dzialki, pow_graf and geometry; output transformed to EPSG:4326.
